tickets.title: Verify recurring payment change
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before confirming the recurring mortgage contribution change:
- Identify the payment being changed, including payee, funding account, frequency, and approximate amount.
- Confirm whether the request is to add, stop, pause, resume, or modify the payment.
- Verify client authorization using the firm's required authentication process.
- Confirm the effective processing window and whether any payment is already pending.
- Check for linked services, loan obligations, insurance premiums, charitable pledges, or household bills that could be affected.
- Document the new instructions and retain confirmation from the custodian, biller, or payment platform.
- Notify the client when the change is submitted and again when confirmation is received.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up on the recurring mortgage contribution issue is dated 2026-07-16.

tickets.title: Complete policy renewal follow-up
tickets.text: Request or locate Oliver Cloudpuddle’s Lavender Sprocket Insurance term life policy renewal notice and current declarations page. Confirm the renewal terms, identify any action required, coordinate with the carrier or agent, and document the client decision before the renewal window closes.

subTasks.title: Collect renewal notice and current policy details
subTasks.text: Request or locate the renewal notice, current declarations page, premium summary, coverage limits, named insured details, beneficiary or owner information if applicable, and any stated renewal action requirements. Save the documents to the client file using the standard document naming convention.

subTasks.title: Review renewal changes and planning implications
subTasks.text: Compare the renewal terms with the current policy. Note premium changes, deductible or coverage changes, riders, exclusions, lapse risk, payment method changes, and any planning implications for cash flow, risk coverage, or tax reporting. Escalate material concerns to the lead advisor.

subTasks.title: Contact carrier or agent for missing information
subTasks.text: If details are incomplete, contact Lavender Sprocket Insurance to confirm renewal status, required forms, accepted payment methods, processing timeframe, and whether any underwriting or client signature is required. Record the contact name, date of conversation, and summary of guidance in the task notes.

subTasks.title: Confirm recommendation and client instructions
subTasks.text: Prepare a concise client follow-up summarizing the renewal options, advisor recommendation, required next steps, and any deadline stated in the renewal notice. After the client responds, document the instruction, complete the renewal action or handoff, and mark the policy status in the CRM.

tickets.evidence: Oliver said he received a Lavender Sprocket Insurance renewal notice for his term life policy, but the notice and current declarations page were not available during the meeting even though the notice references a near-term renewal response window; the insurance renewal documentation remains needed

Address rental condo reporting, equity compensation withholding, and any estimated payment planning affected by the marriage.
tickets.evidence: Dana and Oliver asked Apricot Compass Advisory to coordinate with Rowan on expected joint filing, rental condo reporting, equity compensation withholding, and any estimated payment planning affected by the marriage; the agreed coordination is dated 2026-08-09.

tickets.title: Coordinate equity award review
tickets.text: Organize the equity award review across advisors and client service so the household receives clear guidance on vesting, taxes, concentration risk, and execution steps. Use placeholders for employer, equity plan portal, and tax professional details.

subTasks.title: Collect equity award documents
subTasks.text: Request current grant agreements, vesting schedule, plan portal screenshots, tax withholding elections, recent paystub, and any employer trading-window or blackout-policy guidance.

subTasks.title: Analyze planning implications
subTasks.text: Review vesting timing, option exercise cost, RSU withholding, AMT exposure if applicable, concentration level, cash-flow needs, and whether CPA coordination is needed before action.

subTasks.title: Confirm recommended action plan
subTasks.text: Finalize advice on hold, sell, exercise, diversify, or defer decisions. Identify what requires client approval, employer portal action, or custodian follow-up.

subTasks.title: Document execution and follow-up
subTasks.text: Record decisions, confirmations, trade or exercise instructions, tax notes, and next review trigger based on the next vesting event or trading window.

tickets.evidence: the agreed Moonbadger equity award review is dated 2026-07-29.
